login.title: Maytronics Account
login.email_hint: Enter the email address you use for the MyDolphin Plus app. We'll email you a sign-in code.
login.code_hint: Enter the code sent to __email__. It is valid for 5 minutes.
login.error_code_required: Please enter the code from the email.
login.error_no_robot: No robot is linked to this account. Add your robot in the MyDolphin Plus app first.
login.error_wrong_robot: This account is linked to a different robot than this device.

device.error_login_required: Maytronics now signs in with an emailed code. Repair this device to sign in again.
device.error_login_expired: Your Maytronics sign-in has expired. Repair this device to sign in again.
